pages.text: Bleeding:$(br)- slight — up to $(cfg)30$() ml/min, clots by itself in ~$(cfg)4$() min;$(br)- moderate — up to $(cfg)150$();$(br)- heavy — up to $(cfg)300$();$(br)- $(l)arterial$() — ~$(cfg)550$() ml/min, tourniquet or surgery only.$(br2)$(l)Internal$() bleeding is invisible: pale, weak, falling pressure. Needs a surgeon or TXA.
